name: gemini-review
description: Gemini reviews each git commit the model runs, with the staged diff and the conversation, and stops a commit with a serious bug, a security hole or a committed secret. /gemini-review sets on/off, the model and the tier. Needs function hooks (early access).

apiKey.title: Gemini API key
apiKey.description: Leave empty to use the GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.

tier.title: Gemini tier
tier.description: free: Google may use the conversation and the diff to improve its products and human reviewers may read them. paid: a billing-enabled key. /gemini-review free|paid overrides it.

model.title: Gemini model
model.description: The model that reviews. /gemini-review model <id> overrides it.

maxInputChars.title: Maximum characters of conversation sent to Gemini
maxInputChars.description: Above it the longest tool outputs of the conversation are cut to their head and tail before sending. The diff is always sent whole.
